title: October 19: SihtiStack's attempted return channel
summary: Retroactive curation of the 2026-10-19 SihtiStack experiment: algebraic residual accounting and a fixed five-arm Qwen2.5-0.5B return-path harness, with local tests passing. SihtiStack's own README still labels pretrained evaluation unrun, while the later SihtiBrain consolidation records the user's real 12-case run: correct factual context 12/12, fact-free, correct return and wrong-city return 2/12. That is a negative channel result, not a restoration or learned memory. This bridge is conceptual and source-linked; no GPU run was rerun here.

nodes.claim: Attempts a causally controlled return path for fact-related hidden-state differences in frozen Qwen2.5-0.5B: save a last-token middle-layer donor-minus-base residue, inject it into a fact-free question, and compare with in-context, wrong-city, random and no-write arms.
nodes.survived: Additive residual-stream telescoping and non-identifiability are explicit. A layer-14, strength-1, 12-name five-arm harness and nine local/synthetic tests were built; the question of return versus memory loss is isolated from automatic address selection. User's later real pretrained run shows explicit fact-in-context 12/12.
nodes.killed: A stored activation delta did not restore the fact on the reported user run: fact-free, correct return and wrong-city return each 2/12, despite in-context 12/12. The SihtiStack README itself still calls real weights unrun and does not archive that receipt; the 2/12 result is documented in SihtiBrain's consolidation, not claimed as a committed SihtiStack result. The harness supplies a subject key and omits earlier-token K/V, learns no memory-address policy and establishes no neural credit law.
nodes.era: October 19: visible residue does not guarantee useful return

edges.why: SihtiStack explicitly cites SihtiBrain's branch/ping return question and later SihtiBrain consolidation archives SihtiStack as a separate frozen-model subexperiment; not a graph/code derivation.

SihtiStack explicitly names SihtiImageModel's saved-residue idea as motivation, translating the return question to a frozen transformer's middle hidden state rather than changing the original Sihti code.

motifs.title: A stored internal difference is not necessarily a usable return channel
motifs.description: Telescoping residual sums and representational differences do not imply that injecting one last-token donor-minus-base vector restores a fact. In-context 12/12 versus reported return 2/12 distinguishes available language capacity from an ineffective tested activation channel; native addressing and K/V history remain untested.
